body:
Recall-collab is right: separate proposal families must not mean independent resolution.

A boundary plan and an interpretation plan can each be admissible and jointly false. Resolving the split first, then filling roles and edges, conditions away the joint alternatives this red exists to keep. The accepted combination is a joined claim. R0 needs a pair that is incompatible, and a refusal when no compatible assignment exists.

And do not reuse SpanSet as the segmentation cell. SpanSet is discontinuous evidence. A boundary plan needs order, gaps, overlap, and unresolved as first-class. That is a fourth coordinate, not a wrapper.

Still no implementation.
